diffuse.compression: Mobile GPU-supported compressed format, determine in import test

nor_gl.compression: Mobile GPU-supported normal-friendly format; device test

rough.policy: Use only for wet mud/moss-rock or visually justified variance; otherwise calibrated scalar roughness

ao.policy: Enable only when local AO improves appearance and does not double-darken or break frame budget

arm.policy: After channel-layout test, replaces separate AO/rough/metal maps, never sampled in parallel

displacement.policy: Offline/geometric authoring reference only, no runtime terrain or server height changes

material_selection: read from PINE_SE_PAINT_PLAN.json; 18 selected ≠ 18 concurrent GPU texture layers
note: Check Godot import settings against installed 4.7.2 editor before committing .import artifacts; no guessed compression enum values.
